map.高温蠕变寿命计算（Larson-Miller 参数法） 使用指南: High-temperature Creep Life Calculation (Larson-Miller parameter method) User Guide
map.算法：绝对温度 TK = 温度+273.15；Larson-Miller 参数: Algorithm: absolute temperature TK = temperature + 273.15; Larson-Miller parameter LMP = A − 5000×log10(stress), A the material constant; solve LMP = TK×(log10 t + C) back for log10 t ...
map.按 Larson-Miller 参数法由温度与应力估算断裂时间: Estimate rupture time from temperature and stress by the Larson-Miller parameter method
map.输出 LMP 参数与蠕变寿命: Output the LMP parameter and creep life
map.对比不同温度/应力下的寿命衰减: Compare life degradation at different temperatures and stresses
map.按熔点判据判断是否进入蠕变区间: Judge by melting point criterion whether the creep range is entered
map.高温部件定寿：锅炉、汽轮机、化工管道按温度与应力算断裂时间: Life setting for high-temperature components: compute rupture time from temperature and stress for boilers, steam turbines and chemical piping
map.工况评估：升温或加载后蠕变寿命的衰减量化: Duty assessment: quantify creep life degradation after temperature rise or load increase
map.材料比选：对比 Cr-Mo 钢、奥氏体不锈钢、镍基合金的蠕变门槛: Material comparison: creep thresholds of Cr-Mo steel, austenitic stainless steel and nickel-based alloys
map.输入材料常数 C 与 A（由持久强度试验回归）: Enter the material constants C and A (regressed from stress-rupture tests)
map.输入材料熔点以校核蠕变门槛: Enter the material melting point to check the creep threshold
map.点击计算，读取 LMP 与断裂时间: Click calculate and read LMP and rupture time

map.铁基耐热钢 C≈20、镍基合金常取 22；A 应优先采用材料手册或厂家数据: Iron-based heat-resistant steel C ≈ 20, nickel-based alloys usually 22; A should preferentially come from material handbooks or manufacturer data
map.显著蠕变的最低温度约为熔点（热力学温度）的 0.3~0.4 倍: The lowest temperature for significant creep is about 0.3 to 0.4 of the melting point (thermodynamic temperature)
map.低于蠕变门槛可按静强度设计: Below the creep threshold, design by static strength
map.蠕变寿命对温度极敏感，须用实测壁温代入计算: Creep life is extremely sensitive to temperature, so a measured wall temperature must be used
map.Larson-Miller 参数 C 通常取多少？: What value is usually used for the Larson-Miller constant C?
map.对多数铁基耐热钢 C≈20（本工具默认值），镍基合金常取 22 左右；A 由材料: For most iron-based heat-resistant steels C ≈ 20 (this tool's default), nickel-based alloys usually take about 22; A comes from regression of the material's stress-rupture tests, about 30,000 for Cr-Mo steel and up to 50,000 for nickel-based alloys, and material handbooks or manufacturer data should be preferred.
map.为什么蠕变门槛取熔点的 40%？: Why is the creep threshold taken as 40% of the melting point?
map.金属发生显著蠕变的最低温度约为熔点（热力学温度）的 0.3~0.4 倍，工程中常: The lowest temperature at which metals creep significantly is about 0.3 to 0.4 of the melting point (thermodynamic temperature), and engineering commonly uses 0.4 as the criterion; below it the creep rate is tiny and design by static strength is acceptable.
